subject: gk
question: As of the December 2022, which of the following cities of India was NOT a Railway Zone?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Udaipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Northern Railways is the largest zone (out of the 18) in terms of kilometres covered (approximately 6807) in India.
 
• Formally established in the year 1952.
 
• Northern Railway now comprises of 5 Divisions-Ambala, Delhi, Ferozpur, Lucknow and Moradabad.
 
• The key commodities carried by the zone are Iron & Steel, Raw material for Iron & Steel, Cement, Food grains, fertilizer, POL and other commodities.
 
• In 1986, it became the first zone to launch the computerised passenger reservation system in the country.
